questions: Are adjacent swaps allowed to cross the boundary between positions 1 and N, i.e., is the string considered circular?
If multiple optimal contiguous segments exist (same minimal operations), is any allowed, or must we choose a specific one (e.g., leftmost)?
Does swapping two identical characters (0-0 or 1-1) count as an operation, and if so, is it allowed?
Is the cost of swapping two characters always 1 regardless of their values or positions?
Can we choose the same i multiple times consecutively, effectively moving a character more than one position per operation?
Must the final contiguous block of 1s be in the same order as originally, or can the relative order of 1s change?
Is the input guaranteed to be a string of exactly N characters, and could there be leading/trailing whitespace in S?
If there are multiple 1s, can they be moved to any contiguous segment, or must they be gathered to a specific target (e.g., around the median position)?
